repo_notes.content: This repository aggregates many public LiveKit repositories under ./livekit/**. Prioritize documenting these top-level areas with clear links to their directories: SDKs (python-sdks, rust-sdks), Agents Framework (agents, agents-js), Client SDKs (list each client-sdk-*), Server-side (sip, server-sdk-go, list each server-sdk-*), and Examples (livekit/agents/examples and key subfolders). Use a concise hierarchy that stays within page limits and mirrors the logical structures diagram provided. For Python agents assume user is asking about python code unless otherwise specified.
